name: emacare-platform
description: EmaCAre - E-commerce platform for selling Habesha products to diaspora communities

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @emacare/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @emacare/auth-service" "npm run dev -w @emacare/product-service" "npm run dev -w @emacare/order-service" "npm run dev -w @emacare/cart-service" "npm run dev -w @emacare/payment-service" "npm run dev -w @emacare/shipping-service" "npm run dev -w @emacare/notification-service"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @emacare/shared-utils && npm run build -w @emacare/mongo && npm run build -w @emacare/prisma && npm run build -w @emacare/api-gateway && npm run build -w @emacare/auth-service && npm run build -w @emacare/product-service && npm run build -w @emacare/order-service && npm run build -w @emacare/cart-service && npm run build -w @emacare/payment-service && npm run build -w @emacare/shipping-service && npm run build -w @emacare/notification-service
